section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Emotional vulnerabilities', details the instruments used to assess emotional vulnerabilities. It describes the 21-item Beck Depression Inventory-2nd Edition (BDI-II) for depressive symptoms, the 38-item Multidimensional Anger Inventory (MAI) for dispositional anger and expression, and the 8-item UCLA Loneliness Scale (UCLA-8) for subjective feelings of loneliness. Response scales for each instrument are also provided.
